fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-05-07, a certificate carrying the details of the complainant was allegedly altered and submitted to obtain a benefit worth Rs. 2,50,000. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-05-04 at about 09:50. Contact details given by the complainant, Babu Selvam, include the number 9000000442. Karthik Rajan (9000000091) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant alleged that Mathan Raman may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000187. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Certificate allegedly altered and submitted with an application.
fields.Keywords: fake certificate, forgery, morning, witness statement, suspect, witness, documents, shopping complex
